buyers.name: Rhythm Art Gallery
buyers.kind: Gallery with interior & corporate art advisory
buyers.evidence: Mumbai gallery selling original Indian paintings, with a published Interior & Corporate Art Advisory service and a stated aim of backing young Indian artists.
reasons: Has a dedicated corporate and interior art advisory
Sells original Indian paintings online and from its Mumbai space

buyers.name: Image Art Gallery
buyers.evidence: Mumbai gallery founded in 1999, presenting original contemporary and traditional Indian paintings by emerging and established artists. Corporate services are not stated on its site.
reasons: Shows traditional as well as contemporary Indian paintings
Long-established Mumbai collector audience

buyers.name: The Art Hub Gallery
buyers.evidence: DLF Phase-1 gallery (with a second space in South Extension, New Delhi) offering art advisory and custom commissions for homes, hotels and commercial spaces.
reasons: Takes custom commissions for residences, hotels and offices
Runs art advisory for clients unsure what suits a room

buyers.name: Knowledge Center, M3M Broadway
buyers.kind: Design hub for architects & interior designers
buyers.evidence: A 100,000 sq ft permanent exhibition hub on Golf Course Extension Road for architects and designers, which has hosted art-and-design events in 2026. It is a design destination, not a gallery.
reasons: Architects and interior designers here specify art for high-end homes and offices
Hosts art-led events that could suit an introduction

buyers.name: Gallery G
buyers.evidence: Bengaluru art resource offering consultancy to collectors, investors, architects and interior designers, including curating for public spaces.
reasons: Advises architects and interior designers who place art
Curates art for public spaces

buyers.name: Artisera
buyers.kind: Online-first gallery with a Bengaluru space
buyers.evidence: Online-first gallery with a physical space in Bengaluru, selling contemporary Indian art and traditional Indian art to collectors.
reasons: Sells traditional Indian art alongside contemporary work
Serves an online collector base

buyers.name: Shades Creative Gallery
buyers.evidence: Koramangala gallery that describes itself as an art gallery and art consultants, with local-artist support noted in visitor reviews. Services are not detailed on its site.
reasons: Koramangala gallery that backs local artists
Publishes a WhatsApp enquiry line

buyers.name: Hyd.Art
buyers.evidence: Madhapur gallery that lists institutional and corporate sales, art acquisitions and custom commissions for homes, offices and hotels, and invites portfolios for curator review.
reasons: Invites artist portfolios for curator review
Offers corporate sales and commissions for offices and hotels

buyers.name: Kadari Art Gallery
buyers.evidence: Jubilee Hills gallery relaunched in 2019 by an interior designer to connect art with design, and part of Hyderabad Art Week 2026.
reasons: Design-led, so a natural route to interior clients
Active in the Hyderabad art-week circuit

buyers.name: Gallery Splash
buyers.evidence: Describes itself as an art gallery in Delhi NCR and Gurgaon selling contemporary, abstract and original paintings online with worldwide shipping; lists exhibitions in New Delhi and Gurugram. A street address, pricing and artist-submission route were not found on its home page.
reasons: Sells original paintings online and runs exhibitions in Delhi and Gurugram
Fits her contemporary texture canvases more than her deity work

buyers.name: Art Life Gallery
buyers.evidence: Describes itself as an art gallery in Delhi, Gurgaon and Delhi NCR selling original contemporary, folk and acrylic art online. Prices seen on its home page run from about €26 to €7,200. Full address and artist-submission route were not found.
reasons: Lists acrylic and folk originals across a wide price range, close to her ₹3,000–₹30,000 band
Has editorial content on devotional art traditions

buyers.name: Exotic India Art
buyers.evidence: Online marketplace listing original Hindu deity paintings by many artists in acrylic, oil and watercolour, at about $109 to $6,469 on the page checked. Headquarters and any artist-onboarding page were not found, so treat this as a price and demand reference first.
reasons: Shows buyer demand and price points for Kali, Shiva, Krishna and Ganesha paintings
Possible resale channel if it accepts new artists (unconfirmed)

buyersNote: Organisations that serve corporate and private collectors. RoamWise does not list or contact private individuals; introductions go through galleries, advisors and design studios. Inclusion is not a partnership, an order or confirmed interest.

spotlight.label: Painting of the week
spotlight.note: Shiva in meditation above snow peaks, painted by Natasha Guleria. A fitting companion for anyone planning a Himalayan yatra.

plans.note: Founding phase: the first 100 artists get every feature free. From artist 101 the planned tiers below apply; most artists run on autopilot (self-serve, automated) and full hands-on support is Premium only. A thank-you contribution is always optional. RoamWise may also introduce a small commission on sales through RoamWise in future, with written notice. Confirm GST with the CA before charging.
